description.value: Artisan Wine Shop is a specialty BC wine retailer inside North Vancouver's Lonsdale Quay Market, curating small-batch, sustainably farmed wines exclusively from the Okanagan Valley. The shop offers guided in-store tasting experiences led by knowledgeable wine experts, alongside a bi-monthly wine club with access to boutique and rare releases from producers such as CedarCreek, CheckMate, and Road 13 Vineyards. Touring cyclists stopping at Lonsdale Quay can browse a constantly rotating selection of award-winning BC wines and take bottles along for the road.

address.value: 123 Carrie Cates Court, North Vancouver, BC
